justification: A depicts a single, fully three-dimensional standing figure holding raised objects, rendered with naturalistic anatomy and body markings, while B is a low-relief carved slab with small seated/kneeling figures, offering tables, and rows of hieroglyphic script arranged in registers. There is no shared distinctive motif, pose, or relationship between figures and objects—only the broad, universal category of 'human figure' overlaps, which is too generic to indicate any shared iconographic tradition.
